title: Complimentary Weekday Sculpture Park Entry for MP Locals at Pt. Leo Estate
summary: Mornington Peninsula and Frankston residents receive complimentary weekday entry to the Sculpture Park at Pt. Leo Estate throughout winter. Proof of local address required. T&Cs apply.
bookingRequired: Yes (check T&Cs for local resident requirement)
suitableFor: Peninsula and Frankston residents; local families; weekday visitors who live locally
accessibilityNotes: Sculpture park has accessible paths; contact Pt. Leo for specific requirements
weatherDependency: Outdoor sculpture park - Winter walks are excellent here, dress appropriately
nearbyAttractions: Merricks General Store; Stonier Wines; Balnarring Village
suggestedItineraryPairing: Weekday Sculpture Park walk (free for locals), lunch at Merricks General Store, afternoon tasting at Stonier
editorVerdict: The Pt. Leo Sculpture Park normally costs more than most locals realise. This is the offer to use it all winter on weekdays.
editorNote: Pt Leo Estate's complimentary weekday sculpture park entry for locals ran through winter and has finished. Check the estate for current entry conditions.
